weapon.d: At start of turn, if unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants "unit cannot be slowed by terrain (does not apply to impassable terrain)" and "Special cooldown charge +1 per attack during combat (only highest value applied; does not stack)" to unit for 1 turn. If unit initiates combat or is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Res+5 to unit during combat.

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Res.
Boosts damage by 80% of unit's Res.

a.d: If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Res+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces; max 3).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Res+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces + 2; max 5).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Res+X to unit during combat (X = 2 × number of allies within 2 spaces, + 1; max 7).

c.d: Adjacent infantry allies gain: "If foe initiates combat, grants Special cooldown charge +1 per attack during combat. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)"
Adjacent infantry allies gain: "If foe initiates combat, grants Def/Res+1 during combat and Special cooldown charge +1 per attack. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)"
Adjacent infantry allies gain: "If foe initiates combat, grants Def/Res+2 during combat and Special cooldown charge +1 per attack. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)"
